formal_statement: ∃ C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit, PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.Monotone2 C ∧ C.size ≤ 19 ∧ (∀ x : Fin 10 → Bool, (C.eval (List.ofFn x) = true ↔ ∃ u v : Fin 10, (u.val, v.val) ∈ ([(0, 1), (1, 2), (2, 3), (3, 4), (4, 0), (0, 5), (1, 6), (2, 7), (3, 8), (4, 9), (5, 7), (6, 8), (7, 9), (8, 5), (9, 6)] : List (ℕ × ℕ)) ∧ x u = true ∧ x v = true))
plain_statement: Is there a circuit of AND and OR gates, each reading at most two wires, with at most 19 gates in all, whose output on 10 inputs is true exactly when two inputs joined by an edge of the Petersen graph are both true? Edges: i to i+1 mod 5 and i to i+5 for i below 5, and 5+i to 5+((i+2) mod 5). No witness is known (the cover circuit has 20 gates); a witness or the negation is wanted. Conjecture either way.
title: Search: a monotone fan-in-two circuit with at most 19 gates computing the edge function of the Petersen graph
